independence_declaration.statement:
I (domain-reviewer) wrote no implementation in the reviewed scope.
- transformation-analyst wrote the analysis, register, coverage files, glossary, field inventory, journeys, permissions matrix, acceptance map and stage plan.
- delivery-orchestrator wrote the agent definitions, runner, write guard, gate tooling, extraction scripts and delivery records.

I formed this verdict without reading any other round-16 review record. I wrote only review evidence under docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG0/domain/round-16/, plus this record. I executed code only in disposable clones under my private $TMPDIR.

checks_run.procedure: Confirm the frozen candidate. Record the main-repository HEAD and recompute the candidate ID there. List the paths changed after the freeze. Clone the repository into $TMPDIR, check out the candidate commit and recompute the ID there too.
checks_run.command: git rev-parse HEAD; node tools/gates/candidate.mjs --stage DG0; git diff --name-only 4fd56d4d..HEAD; git clone -q /home/user/My-owns $TMPDIR/rv && git -C $TMPDIR/rv checkout -q 4fd56d4d && (cd $TMPDIR/rv && node tools/gates/candidate.mjs --stage DG0)
checks_run.environment: Process sandbox (D-030) with nested Claude Code Bash sandbox, no network; node; disposable clone $TMPDIR/rv
checks_run.expected: The candidate ID recomputes to sha256:3013023a…0d84db9. Any post-freeze commit touches only delivery metadata that D-005 excludes.
checks_run.actual: The main-repository HEAD is 476595d, not the candidate commit. Its only post-freeze commit ('freeze round-16 candidate, round-16 assignments') touches assignments, the candidate manifest and stages.json, all D-005 metadata. candidate.mjs prints sha256:3013023aa21da2f42b3bb279bd094fa0a1879a2bb1c65fd4b1e4e0c050d84db9 in both the working tree and the clone at 4fd56d4d. review-common.md allows this case. Every check below ran against the clone at 4fd56d4d.

checks_run.procedure:
Item 1. Unzip the docx in $TMPDIR with Python zipfile and confirm its SHA-256. Then compare the text independently of tools/source:
- Forward: split every w:p paragraph of word/document.xml and footer1.xml at w:br/w:cr/w:tab, join the w:t runs, normalise (NFKC, quotes, whitespace, markdown punctuation), and require each segment to appear in playbook.md.
- Reverse: every markdown line and table cell of playbook.md, with anchor comments removed, must appear in the concatenated docx text.
checks_run.environment: Python 3 standard library, clone at 4fd56d4d, docx extracted to $TMPDIR/dx
checks_run.expected: The docx SHA-256 is 2584a352…548ad2. Every docx text segment, including table cells and the running footer, is in playbook.md. playbook.md contains no text absent from the docx.
checks_run.actual: SHA-256 2584a35282804e639a697478eae75a55a43cfb8c551345dfc7636b9b34548ad2. All 1028 segments are present (0 missing). The running footer 'BUSINESS TRANSFORMATION PLAYBOOK | PRACTICAL EDITION' appears in the extractor header comment, as the F-DG0-004 fix intended. The reverse direction finds 0 markdown fragments that are not in the docx. All 165 block anchors B0001–B0165 are present.

checks_run.procedure: Item 2. Dump every block's text next to its disposition, requirement IDs and rationale, and read all 165 manually. Mechanically check: each REQUIREMENT block has requirements; each cited requirement exists and cites the block back in source_ref. Separately, check each cell of each REQUIREMENT table block against the register and the analysis documents, to find dropped value lists, examples, bands or questions.
checks_run.command: python3 domain-checks-r16.py (section [2]); manual reading of 02-source-coverage-dump.txt; per-cell substring scan of REQUIREMENT blocks against requirements.csv and docs/analysis/*.md
checks_run.expected: 165 rows with sensible dispositions and true CONTEXT/NON-REQUIREMENT rationales. No source substance dropped.
checks_run.actual: 165 rows (129 REQUIREMENT, 29 CONTEXT, 7 NON-REQUIREMENT) and 0 back-reference inconsistencies. The CONTEXT rows are headings and labels, each pointing to the rows that cover its section. The NON-REQUIREMENT rows are the cover title, strapline, figures, version stamp, reference URLs and the 'extend with Excel/PowerPoint' advice; their rationales are true. Every table cell carrying substance is either in the register or in the analysis docs (field inventory, glossary). Where a requirement seeds 'verbatim from Bxxxx' (the B0029 workstream questions, the B0150 health-check questions, the B0156 'Used for' text), the text lives in playbook.md itself, and the row cites the block and demands verbatim seeding in its acceptance. Nothing was dropped.

checks_run.procedure: Item 3. For T01–T16 and the charter, take the source column headers (for T05 and the charter, the field rows) from playbook.blocks.json. Require each one verbatim in the input_fields of the register rows with that template_id, and in field-inventory.md. Then check the source value lists and seeds verbatim in the register: H / M / L, Support / Neutral / Resist, Decision / Tech / Data / Vendor, Risk/Assumption/Issue/Dependency, A/R, 25/25/20/15/15, the wave horizons, the T11 SLAs, the T10 RAG texts and the bands. Also read each template row's procedure and acceptance against the source.
checks_run.command: python3 domain-checks-r16.py (sections [3], [3b]); manual reading of 03-req-pb-rows.txt against playbook.md B0031–B0130
checks_run.expected: 0 missing columns. All value lists are present, and their meaning is preserved.
checks_run.actual:
Every template has 0 columns missing from both the register and the field inventory (T01 6, T02 7, T03 6, T04 7, T05 14, T06 7, T07 5, T08 7, T09 6, T10 3, T11 6, T12 7, T13 7, T14 10, T15 9, T16 9, charter 14). All 24 value-list and seed strings are present. Manual checks of meaning:
- T06 5,4,3,2,1 gives 3.30.
- The T09 example gives 0.02×100000×50 = 100000 SAR.
- T15 Probability is n/a for non-Risk entries.
- T14 CX Value is n/a and excluded from SAR totals.
- The T11 approvers and SLAs match B0099.
- The T12 letters match B0101, with A/R for BAU Handover.
- The waves are seeded verbatim and may overlap.
- The T10 RAG logic is per area, and Decisions is Red when a decision is overdue.

checks_run.command: manual comparison of 03-req-pb-rows.txt with docs/source/playbook.md; grep of B0018/B0134/B0145/B0152 source tables
checks_run.expected: Each deliverable is fully specified, with its source items enumerated or seeded verbatim.
checks_run.actual:
All are fully specified:
- REQ-PB-029 lists all 14 charter fields. REQ-PB-030 has the four-part thesis. REQ-PB-031 has the five questions verbatim.
- REQ-PB-032 covers the five hierarchy levels. REQ-PB-038 and REQ-PB-041 cover the ten dimensions and ten canvas boxes with their prompts. REQ-PB-042 covers the 90–120 minute workshop with conversion into T04 decisions.
- REQ-PB-053 has the ten sections with their sub-classifications. REQ-PB-060 covers the five layers with cadence. REQ-PB-074 covers the six lifecycle steps and outputs. REQ-PB-071 covers the seven indicators.
- REQ-PB-086 covers the three windows. Its acceptance dates the Days 31–60 tasks correctly from 2026-10-01. REQ-PB-087 has the six Day-90 questions.
- REQ-PB-091 and REQ-PB-092 cover the 25 questions and the bands 21-25/16-20/10-15/0-9, with texts matching B0152. REQ-PB-088 and REQ-PB-090 cover the seven roaming elements, the North Star verbatim and the three chains.
- REQ-PB-003 to REQ-PB-005 cover the modes. REQ-PB-014 covers the phases. REQ-PB-015 to REQ-PB-021 cover each gate's question and evidence. REQ-PB-012 covers the six roles with the B0018 accountability text.

checks_run.procedure: Item 5. Mechanical checks: every SOURCE row cites at least one B block; no USER or ENGINEERING row cites a B block; every M block cited by a row lists that row in master-prompt-coverage.csv. Then read the notes of all 93 REQ-PB rows (Playbook / Master-prompt additions / Interpretations) against the cited blocks. Confirm that health-check scoring is labelled an implementation assumption (D-010) and that the analyst's check_pb_provenance.py passes.

checks_run.environment: Python 3, clone at 4fd56d4d; fresh clone $TMPDIR/pf for prefreeze
checks_run.expected: No SOURCE substance lacks a B basis. Master-prompt additions and interpretations are labelled.
checks_run.actual: 0 inconsistencies. All 93 REQ-PB rows separate playbook content from master-prompt additions (with § and M IDs) and from interpretations. Examples: the gate approver default SP, with BO configurable per T11, is labelled an interpretation. So are '3-5' outcomes and '3-7' deliverables as warnings, and the closure rule as an API 409. check_pb_provenance.py reports 93 rows and 0 problems. D-010 records Yes=1/No=0 health-check scoring as an implementation assumption. REQ-S14-001 and REQ-S14-002 are USER rows.

checks_run.procedure: Item 6. Read REQ-PB-001, REQ-PB-002 and REQ-PB-077 (the provenance statement, custom-extension badges and the BRM note, with no-official-PMI scans) and REQ-S15-002 (provisional tokens). Grep the candidate analysis, register, protocol, decisions and agent definitions for affirmative claims of official PMI or Mobily status, certification or brand compliance. Check every #0078FF mention for its provisional label.
checks_run.command: git ls-files docs/analysis docs/delivery/requirements.csv docs/delivery/requirements-spec.md CLAUDE.md docs/delivery/agent-protocol.md docs/delivery/decisions.md .claude/agents | xargs grep -n -i -E 'official (PMI|Mobily)|PMI[- ]certified|certified|brand compliance|official (logo|colour|color)' | grep -v -i -E 'never|not |no |nothing|without|...|provisional|until|claim'; grep '0078FF' ... | grep -v -i provisional
checks_run.expected: No affirmative claim. Provenance is captured as a practical synthesis inspired by PMI/Brightline/BRM with custom extensions, and #0078FF is provisional.
checks_run.actual: The grep finds no affirmative claim. The only #0078FF line without the word 'provisional' is REQ-S15-003 ('white small text on #0078FF is not used for action buttons'), a contrast rule, not a brand claim. REQ-PB-001 shows the B0004 statement verbatim and requires a UI/report scan for 'official PMI standard' and 'PMI certified'. REQ-PB-002 badges the B0158–B0162 custom extensions. REQ-S15-002 seeds the tokens with provenance=provisional.

checks_run.command: python3 regex scan of requirements.csv for the rule keywords, then reading of the rows; grep -n 'G6' CLAUDE.md docs/delivery/agent-protocol.md
checks_run.expected: Each rule is stated correctly, with a testable acceptance.
checks_run.actual:
All seven are correct:
- REQ-PB-063 and REQ-S07-007: with 100% of tasks complete and a KPI below trajectory, the status is Red or Amber, never Green.
- REQ-S03-003: four independent state machines. Setting delivery to Complete leaves the other three unchanged.
- REQ-S08-001: a forecast never enters the validated total. REQ-PB-075: pending Finance validation is excluded.
- REQ-PB-013: validation is FIN-only (403 otherwise). REQ-S08-003 keeps an accountable business owner. REQ-PB-067 and the matrix keep Benefits Validation BO=A, FIN=R.
- REQ-PB-058: a shared 10M benefit is counted once. REQ-S08-013: 60+50 is rejected, and 60+30 shows 10% unallocated.
- REQ-S04-002: an immutable snapshot; completing tasks leaves the gate in Draft.
- REQ-S21-001, CLAUDE.md line 13 and agent-protocol.md line 10: G6 never implies DG7.

checks_run.procedure: Item 10. Read the glossary tables for sensible business Arabic, including the revision table. Check that the journey headings cover all six phases with G1–G6, modular entry, KPI update, Finance validation, the committee workflow, BAU handover and admin publishing. Cross-check the permissions matrix against B0018, T11 (B0099) and T12 (B0101), and confirm the rule that technical admins are not business approvers.

The journeys J2.1–J2.6 run from Diagnose→G1 to Realize→G6, and J3 to J8 cover modular entry, KPI update, Finance validation, committee, BAU handover and admin publishing. In the matrix:
- Charter: SP Ap, BO/FIN Rv. TOM: BO Ap, SP Rv. Business case: SP Ap, FIN U Va. Initiative Delivery (T05): BO Ap. BAU handover: BO Ac.
- T11 'Go-live / scale' is a separate row with BO Ap, and funding reallocation goes to the SteerCo.

summary: PASS with no findings. The playbook extraction is complete in both directions (1028 docx segments; 0 missing, 0 extra). All 165 B blocks and 423 M blocks have correct, bidirectionally consistent dispositions. T01–T16 and charter columns and all source value lists appear verbatim. Every first-class deliverable is fully specified. There are no invented source requirements and no official PMI or Mobily claims. The seven operating-logic rules are stated correctly with testable acceptances. Staging follows §21. The glossary, journeys and permissions match the source roles, T11 and the RACI. prefreeze.sh DG0 passes in a fresh clone.
